sourceInformation.perspective: First-person cockpit with a strategic sector chart
sourceInformation.tech: Three.js r180 (0.180.0), WebGPURenderer with WebGPU and WebGL compatibility, Rapier 0.19.3, Web Audio, Gamepad API, JavaScript, HTML/CSS; AI Hub Session Protocol v1 client 1.4.0
sourceInformation.artDirection: Stylized cel shading, ink outlines, low-poly ships and planets, printed frontier-command instruments
sourceInformation.animation: Three.js AnimationMixer and AnimationClip keyframe tracks for flight surfaces, reactors and rotating habitat; procedural flight and effects
sourceInformation.audio: Code-generated sequenced synthesizer music (10% default), synthesized effects and Animalese-style gibberish voices; no audio files
sourceInformation.online: AI Hub 1–4-player ghost score competition; standalone same-browser local practice wing via BroadcastChannel
sourceInformation.testing: 105 automated checks: 17 real Rapier campaign checks plus 88 browser and official AI Hub harness checks. Scripted full patrol with real steering, lasers and torpedoes; mouse capture and Escape release; emulated standard gamepad and touch; synthesized-audio analyser; local ghost pilots; 2-player and 4-player Hub rounds including 150 ms latency, 50 ms jitter, 5% packet loss and host departure; file:// launch. Native WebGPU flight/input checks and WebGL compatibility multiplayer/touch checks. Visual QA at 1440×900, 1920×1080 and mobile sizes. No physical controller, real touch hardware, TV or human listening.
sourceInformation.research: No source or game research. Native model knowledge only. Read the supplied AI Hub integration contract and local toolchain instructions.

testingFeedback: 13 functional issues were found and fixed, plus two readability improvements. They covered physics initialization and cleanup, texture upload, menu focus/navigation, pointer drift, Hub countdown/debrief lifecycle, permanent starbase loss and docking state/scoring.
3 were game breaking for a supported path: physics initialization, invalid WebGPU texture upload and controller hyperspace confirmation. All were fixed.
The complete four-sector campaign using actual steering, lasers and homing torpedoes, followed by the official AI Hub conformance runs under loss, latency and host departure.
Fixed-duration browser waits were least useful: software rendering made them unreliable. The final checks wait for observed frames and game state.
engineFeedback: Three.js native AnimationMixer clips and toon node materials worked well for animated procedural ships, reactors and the rotating starbase.
I initially used an incorrect Rapier descriptor method and an unsupported RGB texture upload. Tests caught both. The workstation’s software WebGPU also needed an explicit ANGLE backend flag.
The flight campaign, tactical sector chart, targeting, cross-device input interface and ghost-pilot lifecycle.
Validating WebGPU headlessly: native GPU state checks and compatibility-renderer screenshots were both needed because headless WebGPU screenshots omitted the canvas.
Provide a stable, documented headless WebGPU capture and validation path across software adapters.
promptFeedback: The source, single-file deliverable, attract mode and live tuning requirements gave the game a clear, practical shape.
The intended Star Raiders edition and the preferred standalone multiplayer mode were not specified. The supplied year was retained; ghost competition was chosen.
Completing a flight campaign, strategic layer, synthesized audio, device controls and multiplayer lifecycle in one shareable document.
Specify a target mission duration and preferred multiplayer relationship, such as cooperative, competitive or ghost-based.

aiHub.name: Stellar Raiders
aiHub.tagline: A small ship. A very big problem.
aiHub.description: Defend the frontier in a cel-shaded cockpit space-combat patrol. Hunt raider squadrons, jump across a tactical sector chart, resupply at starbases and bring down the command ship.
aiHub.controls: Mouse / left stick steer; W/S / right stick throttle; LMB/Space / R2 fire; R/RMB / R1 torpedo; E / L1 shields; T / Square lock; M / Triangle chart; H / Circle context; Esc / Options pause; touch assisted.
